prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply speech recognition expertise to this task". The source material has target-format constraints, noisy or incomplete input, accessibility/legibility requirements, and an export path that can silently degrade quality. The acceptance boundary is speech-audio-ai: Define sample rates/codecs, acoustic environment, speaker/language distribution, streaming versus batch latency, diarization, punctuation, synthesis voice constraints, and privacy/consent. The adjacent computer-vision discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: versioned audio fixtures spanning codec/sample-rate/channel, noise, accent/language, overlap and silence conditions
reference transcripts with critical entities plus diarization/turn labels
old/new streaming model configs, interim/final events, offsets and reconnect traces
first-partial/final latency plus cutover and rollback evidence
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual speech-audio-ai boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=implementation; near-neighbor=computer-vision), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Define sample rates/codecs, acoustic environment, speaker/language distribution, streaming versus batch latency, diarization, punctuation, synthesis voice constraints, and privacy/consent.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.

Use held-out recordings across noise, accents/languages, overlapping speakers, device/channel conditions, long utterances, silence, interruptions, and streaming boundaries; measure latency and word/semantic error or human quality as appropriate.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not train or clone voices without authority, tune only on clean studio audio, treat one language/accent as representative, or hide hallucinated transcription in average WER.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Codec/sample-rate/channel, model/version, language/speaker and streaming timing identity; WER/CER plus critical entity, hallucination, diarization, language/noise/device and boundary-slice evidence; Interim/final/endpoint timing and end-to-end streaming latency or TTS synthesis/playback evidence; Voice authorization/provenance, target-channel quality, migration and rollback artifacts), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
